metadata.question: Did Sierra Estrella show higher land surface temperature than PHX Airport in July 19, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need Land Surface Temperature (LST) data for July 19, 2023 - Two locations: Sierra Estrella (mountain range in Arizona) and PHX Airport (Phoenix Sky Harbor) - Best collection: MODIS Terra LST (MOD11A1) or Landsat 8/9 with thermal bands - MODIS MOD11A1 has daily LST data at 1km resolution - Landsat 8/9 has 16-day revisit, may not have data on exact date 2. Masking strategy: - Use QA bands to mask poor quality LST pixels - LST is the target variable, not clouds per se, but quality flags matter 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - LST in Kelvin should be ~280-330K for Arizona in July - If result is None/NaN → C3 - If no images found → C1 - If no valid pixels after QA masking → C2 - Compare mean LST values: Sierra Estrella > PHX Airport → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries const sierraEstrella = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.38, 33.35]); // Sierra Estrella approximate center const phxAirport = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.01, 33.43]); // Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport // 2. Date range const startDate = '2023-07-19'; const endDate = '2023-07-20'; // 3. Load MODIS Terra LST collection let col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(sierraEstrella.union(phxAirport)); const colSize = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data available, trying Landsat 9...'); col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate('2023-07-15', '2023-07-25') .filterBounds(sierraEstrella.union(phxAirport)); const landsat9Size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 9 images found: ${landsat9Size}`); if (landsat9Size === 0) { console.log('No images found for the date and location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Process MODIS LST (if available) if (colSize > 0) { const img = col.first(); // LST_Day_1km band in Kelvin * 0.02 scale factor const lstDay = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02); // Apply QA mask (bits 0-1 must be 0 for good quality) const qc = img.select('QC_Day'); const mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); const lstMasked = lstDay.updateMask(mask); // 5. Calculate mean LST for Sierra Estrella const sierraStats = lstMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: sierraEstrella.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const sierraLST = sierraStats['LST_Day_1km_mean']; const sierraCount = sierraStats['LST_Day_1km_count']; // 6. Calculate mean LST for PHX Airport const phxStats = lstMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: phxAirport.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const phxLST = phxStats['LST_Day_1km_mean']; const phxCount = phxStats['LST_Day_1km_count']; console.log(`Sierra Estrella - LST: ${sierraLST ? sierraLST.toFixed(2) : 'null'} K, Pixels: ${sierraCount || 0}`); console.log(`PHX Airport - LST: ${phxLST ? phxLST.toFixed(2) : 'null'} K, Pixels: ${phxCount || 0}`); // 7. Validation and final answer if (sierraCount === 0 || phxCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after QA masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (sierraLST === null || sierraLST === undefined || phxLST === null || phxLST === undefined) { console.log('LST calculation returned null.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (sierraLST < 250 || sierraLST > 350 || phxLST < 250 || phxLST > 350) { console.log('LST values out of reasonable range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (sierraLST > phxLST) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
